texts.Portal:Hero:TitleLine2: and peace of mind for parents
texts.Portal:Hero:Subtitle: Manage attendance, daily reports, parent communication, and child care in one simple platform designed for the modern early education environment.
texts.Portal:HeroCard:Title: Daily report sent
texts.Portal:HeroCard:Body: Leo had a great nap and finished his fruit!
texts.Portal:Features:Heading: Everything you need to bloom
texts.Portal:Features:Subheading: Designed with the warmth of a classroom and the precision of a professional operations tool.
texts.Portal:Feature:Attendance:Title: Attendance tracking
texts.Portal:Feature:Attendance:Body: Seamlessly track arrivals and departures with our digital sign-in kiosk. Get real-time ratios and automated reports for compliance.
texts.Portal:Feature:Reports:Title: Daily reports
texts.Portal:Feature:Reports:Body: Log meals, naps, activities, and photos throughout the day. Automated summaries keep parents informed without the paperwork.
texts.Portal:Feature:Comms:Title: Parent comms
texts.Portal:Feature:Comms:Body: Secure instant messaging, newsletters, and announcements. Build stronger relationships through transparent communication.
texts.Portal:Feature:Comms:Quote: "Sophie had such a great time during the art session today! Check out the photo…"
texts.Portal:Feature:Admin:Title: Nursery administration
texts.Portal:Feature:Admin:Body: Full suite of tools for billing, enrollment, staff management, and compliance reporting. Less time on admin, more time with children.
texts.Portal:Parent:MockCaption: Leo explored primary colors today! He was very focused on his finger painting.
texts.Portal:Parent:Quote: "The app is so easy to use, I feel like I'm part of Leo's day even at work."
texts.Portal:Parent:Heading: Designed for
texts.Portal:Parent:Body: The NurseryHub parent app gives families a direct window into their child's day. Beautiful activity feeds, instant notifications, and digital portfolios build trust and engagement.
texts.Portal:Parent:Point1Body: Photos and videos of milestones delivered in real time to parents' phones.
texts.Portal:Parent:Point2Body: Simple one-click bill pay and automated invoices for easy nursery financing.
texts.Portal:Trust:SafeBody: Bank-level encryption for all sensitive child and family data. GDPR-aligned practices you can trust.
texts.Portal:Trust:NurseryBody: Built in collaboration with early years experts so it works for real classroom workflows.
texts.Portal:Trust:ParentBody: A delightful interface parents actually love using, leading to strong engagement.
texts.Portal:Cta:Heading: Ready to transform your nursery management?
texts.Portal:Cta:Body: Join over 2,500 nursery managers who have simplified their day-to-day operations with NurseryHub.
texts.Portal:Footer:Tagline: © 2024 NurseryHub. Dedicated to early childhood excellence. Empowering educators and connecting families through thoughtful technology.
texts.Portal:Footer:Bottom: Proudly made for little learners everywhere
